parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are added to the resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --resource-type ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE --resource-id demo.xxxaliyundoc.com-waf --tag Value=TagValue1 Key=Tagkey1 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'demo.xxxaliyundoc.com-waf' --Tag.1.Key Tagkey1 --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --Tag.1.Value TagValue1 --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
